description: Non-working days (días inhábiles) for computing administrative deadlines (Ley 39/2015, art. 30). Saturdays and Sundays are always inhábiles. 'national' = holidays common to every comunidad autónoma that fall on a weekday; regional lists are keyed by NUTS2 code and add the region's own holidays (including Jueves Santo when the region keeps it). Local (municipal) holidays are NOT included.
sources: BOE: Resolución de la Dirección General de Trabajo, relación de fiestas laborales para 2026 (anexo por CCAA)
